title: Affine-chart comparison of geometric and algebraic strict local rings
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $i:\operatorname{Spec}D\hookrightarrow X$ be an affine open immersion [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-open-immersion], and let $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] with image $x$ in this open. Let $\mathfrak p\subset D$ be the prime corresponding to $x$, identify $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field], and let $K\subset\Omega$ be its separable algebraic closure inside $\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Put $L=D_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and choose an algebraic strict henselization $L^{\mathrm{sh}}$ relative to $K$ with a defining pointed-etale colimit cocone and its induced residue map to $K$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let $C=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,\bar x}$ be the chosen affine pointed-neighbourhood ring colimit and $X_{(\bar x)}=\operatorname{Spec}C$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], with structural morphism $\rho:X_{(\bar x)}\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Give $C$ its $D$-algebra structure through the colimit leg for the uniquely lifted geometric point of $\operatorname{Spec}D$. There is a $D$-algebra isomorphism $\theta:C\xrightarrow{\sim}L^{\mathrm{sh}}$ such that
$$\rho\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\theta)=i\circ\operatorname{Spec}(D\to L\to L^{\mathrm{sh}}).$$
Both $C$ and $L^{\mathrm{sh}}$ are strictly henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. The induced residue map $\psi:L^{\mathrm{sh}}\to K$ is surjective with kernel the maximal ideal of $L^{\mathrm{sh}}$, and $\psi\circ\theta$, followed by the inclusion $K\subset\Omega$, equals the canonical geometric-point evaluation $\mathrm{ev}_{\bar x}:C\to\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation]. Hence $\mathrm{ev}_{\bar x}$ has image $K$ and kernel the maximal ideal of $C$, identifying the residue field of $C$ with $K$, and under these identifications the residue-field isomorphism induced by $\theta$ is the identity of $K$.

proof.text: The existing geometric local-structure theorem makes C strictly henselian. The affine-chart ind-etale theorem makes C ind-etale over D with precisely the chart algebra structure, and the chart maximal-ideal theorem gives m_C=pC: cancel i and use faithfulness of Spec to identify its chart map with the specified chart leg. Apply the official chart theorem at the full affine colimit and transport its ring map and maximal ideal through smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso. Its inverse leg equation and the two defining structural-map equations identify the transported structure map with the existing small-model structure map. Where ind-etaleness is used, apply the official chart ind-etale theorem with the spectrum of this comparison isomorphism.

proof.text: The existing ind-etale separability lemma implies that every geometric evaluation value belongs to the fixed relative separable closure K inside Omega. Restrict evaluation to epsilon:C to K. Its composite with D is the original D to kappa(p) to K map, so pC lies in its kernel. Maximality gives ker epsilon=m_C. Factor epsilon through E=C/m_C and extend D to kappa(p) to E by the residue-field universal property. The resulting tower kappa(p) to E to K makes K/E separable, since K/kappa(p) is separable. E is separably closed because C is strictly henselian; hence E to K is surjective. This proves surjectivity of epsilon.

proof.text: Apply local_properties to the given algebraic presentation P: H is strictly henselian and its specified psi=P.residueMap is surjective with maximal-ideal kernel. For s outside p, epsilon(b(s)) is nonzero; thus b(s) is a unit. Localization extends b uniquely to D_p to C, and localization extensionality identifies epsilon after this extension with the given D_p to K map.

proof.text: A private etale-colimit lifting lemma applies the existing single-etale unique lifting theorem to each stage, proves transition compatibility by uniqueness, and descends the resulting cocone. Applying it to P gives f:H to C preserving D_p and residue. The existing ind-etale colimit presentation of C gives the same universal lifting property over D, hence g:C to H preserving D and residue. Localization uniqueness shows g preserves D_p. Apply the etale-colimit lifting lemma again with target H and residue map psi: uniqueness identifies gf with the identity on H. Apply the ind-etale lifting lemma with target C and residue map epsilon: uniqueness identifies fg with the identity on C. Bundle g and f as the ring equivalence theta.

proof.text: The D-map equation for theta and the chart structural-map identity give the scheme equation by contravariance of Spec. The equality psi theta=epsilon gives the evaluation equation. Surjectivity of epsilon and injectivity of K into Omega give its image K and kernel m_C. The first isomorphism theorem applied to epsilon and psi provides the two quotient identifications with K; their equations on representatives identify the induced residue-field map with the identity.
